overview.Name: Costamare Bulkers Holdings Limited
overview.Description: Costamare Bulkers Holdings Limited engages in the ownership and operation of dry bulk vessels worldwide. As of 16 March 2026, it owns 31 dry bulk vessels. The company was incorporated in 2023 and is based in Monaco.
